CustomField.formula:
IF( ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c, 'IM Group (IMGA)'), Account_At_Risk_Flag__c,
IF( IMGA_Lookup__r.At_Risk_Score__c >=10, IMAGE( "/img/msg_icons/error16.png","High Risk"),
IF( AND(IMGA_Lookup__r.At_Risk_Score__c <10,IMGA_Lookup__r.At_Risk_Score__c >=7), IMAGE( "/img/msg_icons/warning16.png","Medium Risk"),
IF( AND(IMGA_Lookup__r.At_Risk_Score__c <7,IMGA_Lookup__r.At_Risk_Score__c >=1), IMAGE( "/img/msg_icons/confirm16.png","Low Risk"), "") ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This is the flag that mirrors the at risk flag on the IMGA: If the IMGA account is red, the child accounts will be red. If the IMGA account is yellow, the child accounts will be yellow.
CustomField.label: IMGA At Risk Flag (DO NOT USE)
